description: This file contains the implementation of the 'FileManager' class in the Admin Controller namespace for OpenCart. It provides functionalities for managing files such as listing directories, uploading files, and handling file paths and permissions within the admin interface.

classes.name: FileManager
classes.description: Controller class for managing files and directories in the admin panel, including listing, uploading, and navigating files.

classes.name: FileManager
classes.description: Controller class for managing files and directories in the admin panel, including listing, uploading, deleting, and folder management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the file manager interface, initializes variables, and renders the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists files and directories within a specified path, supports pagination, filtering, and thumbnail generation.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading of files to the server within a directory, with permission checks and sanitization.

methods.name: folder
methods.description: Creates new directories within the current path, with validation and permissions checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified files or directories, with safety validation and recursive removal.
